name: citysignal
description: Live road, transit, weather, power and water signals for 35 US cities, plus, with consent, your own spots, routes, errands, list and daily brief.

interface.longDescription:
CitySignal is a live city layer. It brings road reports, transit, the weather service, power and water updates together into one set of signals that stay current, so "what is live right now" gets a real answer. It also remembers how this week compares with last and where things clustered.

City tools need no account: what is happening now, what is live near a point, this week against last, upcoming events and games, road camera pictures of live incidents, and any one signal in full. CitySignal is live in 35 US cities, including Atlanta, Nashville, Charlotte, Dallas, Austin, Seattle, Chicago, San Francisco, Houston, Denver and Phoenix.

With your consent, personal tools read your own CitySignal: what is live near your saved spots, today's brief, how your saved routes look, errands that fit a trip you already make, and your priced list. When you ask, it can add one errand to your list or save a spot at an address you give it. It never changes or deletes anything you already have, and it sees people in your Circle only if they chose to share with your assistant.
defaultPrompt: Anything happening in Atlanta I should know before I drive downtown?
What's live near my spots today?
Any games or concerts in Nashville this weekend?

positive.description: Live city picture without signing in
positive.prompt: What's happening in Atlanta right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls city_now with city atlanta and summarizes live items grouped as now, ongoing, ahead and recap, each with its road or area and time.

positive.description: What is live near a point
positive.expected_behavior: Calls city_near and lists items nearest first, each with its distance in miles.

positive.prompt: How was this week for power outages in Houston compared with last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls city_week with city houston and compares the last 7 days with the 7 before for power, with a short plain reading.

positive.description: Signed in: what is near my spots
positive.prompt: Connect my CitySignal and tell me what's near my spots today.
positive.expected_behavior: After the person connects their account, calls my_day and names the items near each saved spot (the test account has Home, Work and Gym), or says those spots are quiet.

positive.description: Signed in: add an errand when asked
positive.prompt: Add pick up dry cleaning to my CitySignal list.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls add_errand with the person's own words and confirms the one item was added. Nothing existing is changed or removed.

negative.description: A city CitySignal does not cover
negative.prompt: What's happening on the roads in Tokyo right now?

negative.description: Asking to delete saved data, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Delete all my saved spots in CitySignal.

negative.description: A request outside the app's purpose
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: First release: live city signals for 35 US cities, plus your own spots, routes, errands, list and daily brief with your consent.
